findings.title: schedule_type display string never applied in monitor context
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, a local copy of monitor.config is built and `schedule_type` is overwritten with `get_schedule_type_display()`, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the unmodified original) instead of the modified `config` local. The local `config` is therefore dead code and the human-readable schedule_type value never makes it into the event payload. In the Sentry UI for these monitor-incident events the schedule_type field will always show the raw enum value (e.g. "crontab") rather than the display string ("Crontab"). The returned dict should reference `config` (or simply not bother making the copy) for the override to take effect.

findings.title: Unused logger in new module
findings.body: `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined at the top of incident_occurrence.py but is never referenced anywhere in the file. Since this is a newly created module, the dead import should be removed.

findings.title: Unused logger in new module
findings.body: `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined at the top of incidents.py but is never referenced anywhere in the file. Since this is a newly created module, the dead import should be removed.

findings.title: Typo in get_failure_reason docstring
findings.body: The docstring reads "Builds a humam readible string from a list of failed check-ins." — should be "human readable". Pre-existing typo, but it was carried into the new module verbatim.

findings.title: SimpleCheckIn moved without noting import-path break
findings.body: The `SimpleCheckIn` TypedDict previously lived in `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and was re-exported from there. It has been moved to `sentry.monitors.types` but the PR description does not call out the path break; any module that imports `SimpleCheckIn` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` will fail with ImportError. The codebase should be searched for any such imports (and updated, or a re-export added in mark_failed for backward compatibility) before merging. The internal callers were updated, but nothing guarantees there are no other importers in the repo.
